Girl Dies in Lorry Accident

A four-year-old girl died in a lorry accident at Balanagar. In a separate incident, a 12-year-old girl was killed and four people were hurt in an accident near Attur in Tamil Nadu. Additionally, a three-year-old girl was beaten to death in Tamil Nadu, and her mother's partner was held by the police. The incidents resulted in the deaths of two young girls and injuries to several others. The police are investigating the circumstances surrounding each incident.
